name: Rusted Scavenger Drone
flavor: A pre-collapse delivery drone, still running its last route for a company that no longer exists.

name: Feral Street Sweeper
flavor: It cleaned these streets for forty years. Now it just circles, brushes worn to wire, cleaning nothing.

name: Signal Wraith
flavor: A knot of looping broadcasts given shape. It speaks in weather reports and station idents.

name: The Archivist
flavor: A server-array that refused to shut down, hoarding every file it could reach. It does not want to be read. It wants to keep.

name: Choir of Lights
flavor: The transit hub's emergency beacons, synchronized into something that sings. Beautiful, and it does not want you to leave.
